name: footer-app-stores
title: App store footer
description: A footer with link columns, the two store buttons drawn in the house style and a QR code slot for visitors at a desk.
docs: stores takes the AppStoreLink shape of AppDownloadHero: a store ("app-store" or "google-play") and its href. appName is required because it goes into the name of each button: "Get Atlas on the App Store" is both what you see and what a screen reader reads. Under sm the buttons stack at the full width and a 48px height. qr is any node, an img or an svg dark on a clear ground; it shows from lg on a white tile, because a scanner needs a light margin in both themes, and a screen reader skips it, as it has the links. The columns and the legal row take the shapes FooterSection takes, and linkAs renders your router's Link. navLabel names the footer navigation, and labels translates the button lines and the caption under the code.
